v84: FAILS - "invalid numeric literal" on the `10n` BigInt literal. That
     hermesc build's lexer does not recognize the ES2020 BigInt suffix at all
     (same reason as 46-bigint-arithmetic), and the `Bigint` bit of
     `TypeOfIsTypes` cannot be exercised without a bigint value.

     `typeof` comparisons lower to `TypeOf` + a string compare. Kept as the
     control that the *answers* are the same either way.
